title: Binance Wallet Launches Prediction Markets API
text: This is a general announcement. The products and services mentioned herein may not be available in your region. Please comply with the relevant terms and conditions. Fellow Binancians, Binance Wallet has officially launched the Prediction Markets API. Eligible users can now access  Prediction Markets  via API, enabling programmatic access and trading. Whether you are building trading bots, quantitative strategies, analytics tools, portfolio management systems, or looking to integrate prediction market functionality into existing products, the Prediction Markets API helps you access market data and trading capabilities through a unified interface. About the Prediction Markets API The Prediction Markets API provides a unified interface that supports core functions such as accessing market data, executing trades, and managing positions. Powered by Binance Wallet’s Prediction Markets infrastructure, it can be quickly integrated into existing applications and trading workflows, enabling automated trading and strategy execution. Eligible users who trade via the Prediction Markets API can earn  Predict Points (PP) . Core Features Access to market-related data Trading and order management Position information and position management Fund transfers Use Cases Development of trading applications and automation tools Quantitative trading and strategy research Market making and liquidity provision Data analytics and market data platforms Integration of prediction markets into existing products and services Get Started You can apply for and manage the Prediction Markets API through the Binance Developer Platform: Developer platform API documentation Prediction Markets API FAQ Eligibility Users must meet the following requirements: Complete identity verification Create a Prediction Account via the Binance App Complete Prediction SAS authorization via the Binance App Enable Prediction Trading permission on the API management page Important Notes: The API is available only to eligible users. This product’s availability varies from region to region. Prediction market trading involves risks. Please carefully assess your risk tolerance before participating. Binance Wallet provides API access as a technical service only. By providing the Prediction Markets API, Binance Wallet makes no representation or warranty that the use of prediction markets is compliant with applicable laws or regulations in any jurisdiction. Users are solely responsible for determining the legality of accessing and using prediction market services in their respective jurisdictions before use. There may be discrepancies between the original English version and any translated versions. In the event of any discrepancy, please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information. Thank you for your support!
